breakdown.description: For curved flow, pressure is higher on the outside of the turn to provide the required centripetal force; stating pressure increases toward the center reverses the correct direction of the pressure gradient.
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully resolved the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly stated that 'pressure increases toward the center of curvature'. The agent removed this erroneous statement and instead provided the correct formula for the pressure gradient, which implicitly defines that pressure increases away from the center of curvature, aligning with the ground truth.
